Merged `main` after #4460 merged. Ready for a re-check.

- Merge commit `3c24051af`. The merge had no conflicts. No hand edits.
- `git diff origin/main --stat` lists only the 12 files of this slice.
- Gate on head `3c24051af` (winbuild lane, one run, log `gate-4468-3c24051.log`):
  - `cargo check -p camcraft-gcode`: clean.
  - `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 3 steps, 0 failed.
  - `cargo clippy -p camcraft-gcode --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
  - `cargo test -p camcraft-gcode --test klartext`: 47 passed, 0 failed.
- The PR stays a draft. The "Stacked on #4460" line is removed from the body.

Ready for a re-check. New head `755d7dce2`. Two fixes from the pre-review:

1. `LP` without `PR` / `PA` (and the base of `IPR` / `IPA`): the reader now uses the last programmed polar value about the current pole, and only when it knows that value exactly. After a Cartesian move (`L`, `C`, `CR`, `CT`) or a `CC` block that moves the pole, the reader refuses the `LP` by name and line, for example "LP without PR: the last polar radius about this pole is not known (write PR)". The same rule applies to `PA`. The decision is in `docs/decisions/2227-klartext-reader.md`, "Polar reference". Pinned by `klartext_lp_refuses_a_polar_coordinate_that_it_does_not_know` and `klartext_lp_keeps_the_last_polar_coordinates_where_they_are_known`.
2. Zero-length move: an `RND` / `CHF` that takes exactly the whole line before or after it now writes no zero-length feed move for that line. Pinned by `klartext_transition_that_takes_the_whole_line_leaves_no_zero_length_move`.

Also new: `klartext_lp_angle_out_of_range_is_refused`, `klartext_rnd_after_a_line_with_m3_or_m8`, `klartext_chf_between_an_l_and_an_lp_line` and `klartext_transition_with_fmax_is_refused`.

Gate on `755d7dce2` (winbuild lane, log `gate-4468-755d7dc.log`): quick gate 3 steps, 0 failed; clippy `-p camcraft-gcode --all-targets -D warnings` clean; `klartext` suite 54 passed. The PR stays a draft.

Quick pass: good. Head `755d7dc` merges cleanly with `main` (the parent #4460 merged). On this head, the quick gate (3 steps, 0 failed), clippy of `camcraft-gcode` and the `klartext` suite (54 passed) are green. An independent pre-review checked the RND/CHF and polar geometry by hand and found no blocking points. The two points from the first pre-review are fixed: an LP or CP without PR or PA now uses the last programmed value only when it is known exactly, and otherwise refuses by name and line; a transition that takes a whole line leaves no zero-length move. I flag the PR ready for review.

Reviewer: MacBook-Pro.local pool job review-4468, claude-opus-5-5, mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a `feat` PR, so it merges at the next cut. Reviewer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4468#issuecomment-7231478617

## What looks good

- The look-ahead design is small. A line that an `RND` / `CHF` follows waits in `pending`. The line after the transition releases it. No move that is already in the toolpath changes.
- The geometry is correct. I checked it by hand. The tangent length is `R tan(phi/2)`, with `phi` the turn angle. The arc centre is on the inner side of the turn. The chamfer cuts the side length from each line.
- The reader refuses each case that it cannot show exactly, with the block name and the line number. Examples: lines in line, a transition longer than its line, `FMAX`, a Z change, M functions at the block end, a transition next to an arc, `CP` from the pole, an unknown last `PR` / `PA`.
- The polar reference rule is conservative. A Cartesian X/Y move or a moved `CC` clears the last `PR` / `PA`, and an `LP` that needs them is then refused. The reader does not guess.
- No `unwrap` / `expect` / `panic!` in the new code. The `as usize` cast in `polar.rs` is bounded: `|sweep| <= 99999.9999`, so `n <= 1112`.
- Each new module has a provenance line. The new tests are submodules of the existing `klartext` directory suite: no new test binary. All files are below 400 lines (the largest is `exec.rs` with 341 lines).
- The decision entry in `docs/decisions/2227-klartext-reader.md` lists what was decided, why, what was dropped and the cost to change later.
- The body has `Refs #2227` (partial work), a `Changelog:` line, the pinning tests and "Not exercised".

## Results (locally, trial merge with `upstream/main` 2394b5ad1)

The PR head already contains `upstream/main`, so the trial merge is the PR head.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 3 steps, 0 failed.
  - `gcode build (--no-run)`: ok
  - `gcode suites: lib`: ok (0 tests)
  - `gcode suites: klartext`: ok, **54 passed**, 0 failed, 0 ignored
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-gcode --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo fmt -p camcraft-gcode --check`: the 12 files of this PR are clean. Other files of the crate show differences, but those differences are also on `main`. They are not from this PR.

**Extra suites run:** none apply. The diff changes no file under `testdata/`, no fixture or golden directory, and no import code (STEP, mesh, kernel).

**Example catalog and goldens:** not applicable. No post, operation, motion or catalog file changed. No recorded program (`*.nc`, `*.cl`) changed.

**Light lane:** not run. No crate depends on `camcraft-gcode` (I checked each `crates/*/Cargo.toml`). The light twins are in `motion` and `app`, so this diff cannot reach them. A light result is not a merge condition.

**Heavy lanes:** not reached and not a merge condition.

## Mutations (local, reverted after each run)

The PR does not change posted G-code, a gouge or collision check, or stock simulation. The reader has no consumer yet. But it computes toolpath geometry, so I ran three mutations:

1. `corner.rs` tangent length `R tan(phi/2)` changed to `R`: **red**, 2 tests failed (`klartext_rnd_on_an_obtuse_corner_is_tangent_to_both_lines`, `klartext_rnd_between_l_and_lp_lines`). On a 90-degree turn the two values are the same, so the obtuse-corner test is the one that catches it.
2. `exec.rs` polar-reference reset disabled (`if false && moved ...`): **red**, `klartext_lp_refuses_a_polar_coordinate_that_it_does_not_know` failed.
3. `corner.rs` `round_center` turn side inverted: **red**, 7 contour tests failed.

## Local probes (scratch test, deleted after the run)

I parsed these inputs and checked each result by hand:

- A comment line between `L` and `RND`, and also between `RND` and `L`: the comment is skipped and the result is correct.
- `LP PA+90` / `RND R2` / `LP PA+180` about `CC X+0 Y+0`: the cut-back points (1.4142, 8.5858) and (-1.4142, 8.5858) and the centre (0, 7.1716) are correct.
- `CP IPA+720 DR+` after `LP PR+10 PA+0`, then `LP IPA+45`: 8 quarter-turn arcs, then the line ends at (7.0711, 7.0711). Correct.
- `CP IPA+99999 DR+ IZ-10`: 1112 pieces, Z linear. No hang.
- `LP IPR-10` to a negative radius, a reversal (`L X+20` then `L X+0`), and `RND R0.001` on a near-reversal: each is refused by name.
- `RND RQ1` with a Q parameter: correct.
- `RND` without F, then a line with `F300`: the arc uses the modal F100, and the line after it uses F300. This agrees with the decision entry.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

1. Two commits use the type `style(gcode):` (`28957402d`, `9e59d4d3c`). `style` is not in the type list of AGENTS.md "Commits and Releases". Merges are merge commits, so these subjects go to `main` as they are. Use `chore` or `refactor` in future slices.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
